data.name: Randolf
data.long_meaning: The Old German name Randolf consists of two parts: 'rand' meaning 'wolf' and 'wolf' meaning 'counselor'. This name was popular among the Germanic people and was often given to those who held a position of leadership or were considered wise.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes strength and wisdom, inspiring confidence and trust.

Randolf was a name given to warriors, chieftains, and counselors, signifying their role in protecting and advising their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Randolf can be seen as a reminder of the wisdom and guidance that comes from God. The wolf symbolizes the fierce and protective nature of God, while the counselor symbolizes God's desire to guide and direct us on our spiritual journey. Randolf can serve as a reminder to seek God's counsel and direction in our lives, and to embody the wisdom and strength that comes from Him.
